rationale: The 95.6 bps bid-ask spread alone consumes most of any realistic intraday edge, and the stock has already collapsed ~6% from its session high in the last two candles — chasing the short here risks entering at exhaustion while the wide spread guarantees significant slippage in both entry and exit. With the daily loss budget already partially consumed and no clear stabilization level established, the risk/reward does not justify a new position.
